newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy bank rates should fall into line - ABI.
newsitem.headline: Italy bank rates should fall into line - ABI.

text.p: Bank rates across the Italian banking sector are expected to be brought into line over the next two or three weeks, Tancredi Bianchi, president of the Italian Banking Association (ABI), said on Tuesday.
A wave of banks have reduced their prime rate by half a point over the past week, but not all Italian banks have followed suit.

"I believe the fall in (bank) rates will continue, the situation favours a fall," Bianchi said. "Soon we will have the data for (December) inflation which I believe will be favourable. In the space of two or three weeks the fall in bank rates will be generalised."
Preliminary December inflation data from 10 Italian cities is due later this week. -- Rome newsroom +396 6782501
